meta.promptText: India mein men ke liye konse brand ki formal shirts kharidni chahiye?

response.text:
Haan—India mein **men’s formal shirts** ke liye main brands ko roughly is tarah rank karunga:

| Brand | Best for | Approx. budget |
|---|---|---:|
| **Louis Philippe** | Premium, classy corporate look | ₹1,500–3,500+ |
| **Van Heusen** | Best all-rounder / daily office | ₹1,000–3,000 |
| **Arrow** | Sharp, polished formal look | ₹1,500–3,500 |
| **Raymond** | Classic look + good fabric | ₹1,000–3,500 |
| **Blackberrys** | Modern, tailored fit | ₹1,500–3,500 |
| **Peter England** | Budget-friendly daily office wear | ₹800–2,000 |
| **Allen Solly** | Modern/semi-formal office style | ₹1,000–3,000 |


Recent 2026 comparisons mein bhi Van Heusen, Louis Philippe, Arrow, Raymond aur Allen Solly consistently strong options hain. [midvey.com](https://midvey.com/blogs/news/top-10-best-formal-shirt-brands-in-india-for-2026?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

### Meri personal shortlist 👔

**🥇 Best overall: Van Heusen**  
Agar ek hi brand choose karna ho, **Van Heusen** lo. Office ke liye crisp, professional aur generally achhi fit variety milti hai.

### [Van Heusen Men Solid Slim Fit Formal Shirt]()
*₹1,029*

**🥈 Premium choice: Louis Philippe**  
Important meetings, client-facing job ya thoda premium look chahiye to **Louis Philippe** better pick hai. [indianretailer.com](https://indianretailer.com/article/consumer-behaviour/consumer-trends/best-formal-shirt-brands-india?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

### [Louis Philippe Men Cotton Fit Formal Shirt]()
*₹1,524*

**🥉 Value + classic: Raymond**  
Classic formal wardrobe ke liye Raymond bhi bahut solid hai.

### [Raymond Men's Solid Formal Slim Fit Shirt]()
*₹939*

### Agar 5 shirts leni hain
Main **2 white + 2 light blue + 1 light pink/lavender** suggest karunga. Mostly **solid ya very subtle stripes**, full sleeves, aur cotton/cotton-blend fabric. Fit brand se bhi zyada important hai—shoulder seam exactly shoulder par aur shirt chest/waist par excessively tight nahi honi chahiye. [www.stylementor.fashion](https://www.stylementor.fashion/2025/09/202509best-formal-shirts-for-office-wear-in-india.html.html?m=1&utm_source=chatgpt.com)

Agar tum **budget bata do (₹1,000 / ₹2,000 / ₹3,000 per shirt)** aur **slim fit ya regular fit**, main tumhare liye **5 exact shirts** shortlist kar sakta hoon.
